'''Banana cream''' is a milk-based [[Cookbook:Dessert|dessert]]. It is based on [[s:Page:Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management.djvu/1124|Mrs Beeton's Book of Household Management]], which is public domain. 

== Ingredients ==
*2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]] (57 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) [[Cookbook:Cornstarch|cornstarch]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Quart|quart]] (950 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 4 cups) [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]
*2 oz (57 g / ¼ cup) [[Cookbook:Superfine Sugar|caster sugar]]
*2 [[Cookbook:Egg Yolk|egg yolks]], beaten
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Vanilla|vanilla]] extract
*2 [[Cookbook:Banana|bananas]], thinly [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]

== Procedure ==
#Mix the cornstarch smoothly with a little milk to form a paste.
#Put the remaining milk into a pan with the sugar. When [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiling]] add the cornstarch paste, and boil for about 10 minutes.
#Let the mixture cool a little, then add the beaten egg yolks, and stir until they thicken. 
#Add the vanilla, the bananas. When cool, pour into the prepared mould.
#Chill for a few hours to set.
